entities.name: Collegiate church of San Martin de Elines, Cantabria
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The church of San Martin de Elines is located in the valley of Valderredible, in the Province of Cantabria, Spain. Initially part of a monastery, St Martin's later became a collegiate church under the jurisdiction of the diocese of Burgos.
